info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Support Tickets Reopens-v1-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Reopen Status API enables users to retrieve a list of support tickets that have been marked for reopening. It provides essential insights into the status and history of these tickets, allowing support teams to effectively manage customer inquiries and expedite resolution processes. Typical consumers include customer support representatives and system administrators who require an overview of reopened tickets for tracking and analysis. This API streamlines workflows by consolidating relevant ticket data, thereby improving customer support efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to reopen a ticket that was previously marked as closed. By using this operation, you can reactivate the ticket for further action, allowing teams to re-evaluate the issues discussed and make necessary updates or resolutions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details necessary to reopen a ticket. Ensure that all required fields are populated as per the schema.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the relevant ticket details are returned.
